name: Going To College
overview: Scripture emphasizes the supreme value of wisdom above all earthly desires, highlighting the importance of pursuing godly understanding as one embarks on the college journey. Early spiritual training and instruction establish a foundation that will guide young believers throughout their lives, ensuring they remain steadfast in their faith amid new challenges. Moreover, the pursuit of knowledge and approval must be motivated by a desire to serve Christ rather than seeking the approval of men, affirming a Christ-centered purpose in all academic endeavors.
